highlight.title: BGP Route Leak Brings Down Major Internet Services
highlight.summary: In May 2025, a misconfigured BGP router caused widespread internet disruptions when it split major IP blocks into smaller parts that shouldn't have been announced globally. The incident highlights how the internet's routing system works like a GPS for data packets - when the directions get corrupted, traffic gets lost or takes impossible detours.

resources.why_now: This October 2025 comprehensive guide covers everything from OSI vs TCP/IP models to modern protocols like QUIC, making it ideal for readers who want deep technical understanding of current networking standards.

claude_take: The recent BGP incidents show that while the internet feels magical, it's actually a fragile collection of routers constantly gossiping about which paths lead where - and when they get confused, millions of people suddenly can't check their email. Understanding these fundamentals isn't just academic curiosity anymore; it's digital literacy for an age where internet outages can literally ground airplanes and crash hospital systems.
